content: The Incremental Cost-Effectiveness Ratio (ICER), expressed in terms of cost per Disability-Adjusted Life Year (DALY) averted, was evaluated in comparison to the baseline scenario (BD) for the Global Burden of Disease (GBD) North Africa and Middle East region, which aligns with the World Health Organization (WHO) Eastern Mediterranean Region. The analysis focused on the North Africa and Middle East region and assessed outcomes for infant vaccination combined with a 90% birth dose (BD) coverage by 2020, guided by high viral load (VL) testing in 2021, and guided by hepatitis B e-antigen (HBeAg) testing in 2021. The number of cases averted under these scenarios were as follows: Infant vaccination + BD 90% by 2020: 223,954 cases averted. PPT guided by high VL (2021): 401,034 cases averted. PPT guided by HBeAg (2021): 362,409 cases averted. The percentage reduction in cases was: 16% for infant vaccination + BD 90%. 29% for PPT guided by high VL. 27% for PPT guided by HBeAg. The number of DALYs averted were: 209,352 for infant vaccination + BD 90%. 353,866 for PPT guided by high VL. 322,704 for PPT guided by HBeAg. When compared to the baseline scenario, the additional cases averted were: 177,080 for PPT guided by high VL. 138,454 for PPT guided by HBeAg. The percentage increase in cases averted compared to the baseline was: 17% for PPT guided by high VL. 13% for PPT guided by HBeAg. The additional DALYs averted compared to the baseline were: 144,515 for PPT guided by high VL. 113,352 for PPT guided by HBeAg. The total costs under different cost scenarios were: Mid-cost scenario: $979,043,443 for infant vaccination + BD 90%, $1,238,819,545 for PPT guided by high VL, and $1,206,075,150 for PPT guided by HBeAg. Low-cost scenario: $1,056,283,339 for PPT guided by high VL and $1,046,653,538 for PPT guided by HBeAg. High-cost scenario: $2,070,060,400 for PPT guided by high VL and $1,818,171,043 for PPT guided by HBeAg. The ICER values (in $ per DALY averted) under different cost scenarios were: Mid-cost scenario: $548 for infant vaccination + BD 90%, $1,058 for PPT guided by high VL, and $1,059 for PPT guided by HBeAg. Low-cost scenario: $543 for PPT guided by high VL and $565 for PPT guided by HBeAg. High-cost scenario: $3,407 for PPT guided by high VL and $2,956 for PPT guided by HBeAg. The ICER values (in $ per case averted) under different cost scenarios were: Mid-cost scenario: $512 for infant vaccination + BD 90%, $934 for PPT guided by high VL, and $943 for PPT guided by HBeAg. Low-cost scenario: $479 for PPT guided by high VL and $503 for PPT guided by HBeAg. High-cost scenario: $3,007 for PPT guided by high VL and $2,632 for PPT guided by HBeAg. The ICER values (in $ per DALY averted) compared to the baseline scenario were: Mid-cost scenario: $1,798 for PPT guided by high VL and $2,003 for PPT guided by HBeAg. Low-cost scenario: $534 for PPT guided by high VL and $596 for PPT guided by HBeAg. High-cost scenario: $7,550 for PPT guided by high VL and $7,403 for PPT guided by HBeAg. The ICER values (in $ per case averted) compared to the baseline scenario were: Mid-cost scenario: $1,467 for PPT guided by high VL and $1,640 for PPT guided by HBeAg. Low-cost scenario: $436 for PPT guided by high VL and $488 for PPT guided by HBeAg. High-cost scenario: $6,161 for PPT guided by high VL and $6,061 for PPT guided by HBeAg. The analysis also included an appendix that approximated the mapping of GBD regions to WHO regions. Due to overlaps between the Western Pacific and South-East Asian regions, these regions were approximated together for the purposes of the results.
